thread.title: Apple, Applied Materials, Intel drive Silicon Valley stock index higher

author: wn.com
title: Apple, Applied Materials, Intel drive Silicon Valley stock index higher

organizations.name: bloomberg silicon valley high technology index

text: The Bloomberg Silicon Valley High Technology Index surged 1.42 percent on Wednesday as shares of some of the region's biggest technology companies gained. The biggest one of all — Apple — jumped 1.65 percent on news that it will create a new corporate campus and 20,000 new jobs in the U.S. and pay Uncle Sam $38 billion as part of a U.S. tax repatriation package. All told, the iPhone maker (NASDAQ: AAPL) has said those efforts will generate some $350 billion in economic impact for the U.S.,… ...
